Measures: how they are computed and how they may be aggregated.

# Terms

* [Active Customers](active-customers.md) - Distinct customers with at least one paid or refunded order in the period. A distinct count, not additive across periods or countries.
* [Average Order Value](average-order-value.md) - Net revenue divided by orders in the same slice. A ratio, so it is never stored per row and never averaged.
* [Monthly Retention Rate](monthly-retention-rate.md) - Share of a cohort's customers who order again N months after their first order. Ratio; combine cohorts by summing customers first.
* [Net Revenue](net-revenue.md) - Revenue from paid orders in EUR after discounts, with refunded orders counted at zero. The money Folio keeps from its orders.
* [Orders](orders.md) - Number of paid or refunded orders. Cancelled orders are not counted.
